body.purpose: Body copy, data and long reading.

shadows.name: control-offset
shadows.purpose: Buttons, dropdown menus and Today data cards at every width.

shadows.name: surface-offset
shadows.purpose: Poster, the band frames and shared workspace cards. The offset is 4px below 64rem and 8px from 64rem.

motion.name: button-press
motion.purpose: The shadow disappears as a bordered button presses down and right.

motion.name: button-transition
motion.purpose: Background, text, position and shadow on bordered buttons.

motion.name: card-hover
motion.purpose: Today data cards lift on pointer hover or focus within. Reduced motion removes the lift.

motion.name: nav-transition
motion.purpose: Background and border change on the navigation trigger.

motion.name: disclosure-chevron
motion.purpose: The chevron turns 180 degrees as the reading panel opens.

motion.name: reduced-motion
motion.purpose: Shortens transitions and animations under the reduced-motion preference.

components.name: Primary button
components.description: The red action for the main task.
components.html: <button type="button" class="ds-button-primary">See what changed<svg width="16" height="16" viewBox="0 0 24 24" fill="none" stroke="currentColor" stroke-width="2" stroke-linecap="round" stroke-linejoin="round" aria-hidden="true"><path d="M5 12h14m-7-7 7 7-7 7"/></svg></button>
components.css: .ds-button-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--red, #d02020); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #121212); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-primary:hover { background: var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-button-primary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-primary { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } } .ds-button-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-primary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Secondary button
components.description: The blue filled action for a supporting task.
components.css: .ds-button-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--blue, #1040c0); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #121212); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-secondary:hover { background: var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-button-secondary:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-secondary { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } } .ds-button-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-secondary:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Outline button
components.description: The default white action turns yellow on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-outline { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 0; background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #121212); font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #121212); transition: background-color 180ms ease-out, color 180ms ease-out, transform 180ms ease-out, box-shadow 180ms ease-out; } .ds-button-outline:hover { background: var(--yellow, #f0c020); } .ds-button-outline:active:not(:disabled) { transform: translate(2px, 2px); box-shadow: none; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-button-outline { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } } .ds-button-outline:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-outline:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Ghost button
components.description: A quiet blue action with an underline on hover.
components.css: .ds-button-ghost { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 1rem; border-radius: 0; background: transparent; color: var(--blue, #1040c0); font: 700 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-align: center; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; border: 0; text-decoration: underline; text-decoration-color: transparent; } .ds-button-ghost:hover { background: var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); text-decoration-color: currentColor; } .ds-button-ghost:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-button-ghost:disabled { opacity: 0.6; cursor: not-allowed; }

components.name: Search field
components.description: A labelled white search field with a blue focus border.
components.css: .ds-field { display: grid; gap: 0.375rem; color: var(--ink, #121212); font: 600 0.875rem/1.25rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field-input { position: relative; display: block; } .ds-field-input svg { position: absolute; top: 50%; left: 0.75rem; transform: translateY(-50%); pointer-events: none; } .ds-field input { display: block; box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.75rem 0 2.25rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #121212); font: 500 1rem/1.5rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-field input::placeholder { color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--ink, #121212) 70%, transparent); } .ds-field input:focus { border-color: var(--blue, #1040c0); } @media (min-width: 40rem) { .ds-field input { font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; } } .ds-field input:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; }

components.name: Navigation disclosure
components.description: The expanded desktop group with its current route highlighted.
components.html:
Daily monitoring
  • What changed New and changed items since yesterday, and deadlines coming up.
  • Calendar Consultation deadlines, planned adoptions and plenary sittings.
components.css: .ds-nav { color: var(--ink, #121212); font-family: Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-nav-trigger { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.375rem; min-height: 2.75rem; padding: 0 0.625rem; border: 2px solid transparent; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; cursor: pointer; transition: background-color 160ms ease-out, border-color 160ms ease-out; } .ds-nav-trigger::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-nav-trigger:hover { background: var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); } .ds-nav details[open] > .ds-nav-trigger { background: var(--red, #d02020); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); border-color: var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-nav-trigger svg { transition: transform 150ms; } .ds-nav details[open] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-nav-panel { width: min(20rem, 100%); margin: 0.25rem 0 0; padding: 0; list-style: none; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-nav-panel li + li { border-top: 1px solid var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); } .ds-nav-panel a { display: block; padding: 0.625rem 1rem; color: var(--ink, #121212); font-weight: 600; text-decoration: none; } .ds-nav-panel a:hover { background: var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); } .ds-nav-panel a[aria-current="page"] { background: var(--yellow, #f0c020); font-weight: 700; } .ds-nav-panel span { display: block; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; } .ds-nav-trigger:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } .ds-nav-panel a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-nav-trigger, .ds-nav-trigger svg { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

components.name: Status label
components.description: Square labels express availability or a status in words.
components.css: .ds-status { display: inline-block; max-width: 100%; padding: 0.125rem 0.375rem; border: 1px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); color: var(--ink, #121212); font: 700 0.75rem/1rem Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; letter-spacing: 0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-status-warning { background: var(--yellow, #f0c020); }

components.name: Workspace card
components.description: A white work surface with a hard offset and a ruled heading.
components.html:
Legislative files

Watched files with stage, rapporteurs, timeline and votes.
components.css: .ds-workspace-card { --ds-rule: 2px; --ds-offset: 4px; padding: 1rem 1rem 1.25rem; border: var(--rule, var(--ds-rule)) solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #121212); box-shadow: var(--offset, var(--ds-offset)) var(--offset, var(--ds-offset)) 0 var(--ink, #121212); font: 500 1rem/1.55 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-workspace-card header { margin-bottom: 1rem; padding-bottom: 0.75rem; border-bottom: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); } .ds-workspace-card h2 { margin: 0; font-size: 1.25rem; line-height: 1.75rem; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: -0.025em; text-transform: uppercase; } .ds-workspace-card p { margin: 0; } @media (min-width: 40rem) { .ds-workspace-card { padding: 1.5rem; } } @media (min-width: 64rem) { .ds-workspace-card { --ds-rule: 4px; --ds-offset: 8px; } }

components.name: Document disclosure
components.description: A red expanded summary and a pale yellow reading panel.
components.html:
Read published response and attachments
Questionnaire answers only; no written text was published.
components.css: .ds-disclosure { border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); color: var(--ink, #121212); font: 500 1rem/1.55 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-disclosure summary { display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 0.75rem; min-height: 2.75rem; box-sizing: border-box; padding: 0.5rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; line-height: 1.25rem; font-weight: 700; cursor: pointer; } .ds-disclosure summary::-webkit-details-marker { display: none; } .ds-disclosure summary:hover { background: var(--sunken, #e0e0e0); } .ds-disclosure summary svg { flex: none; transition: transform 200ms; } .ds-disclosure[open] summary { background: var(--red, #d02020); color: var(--surface, #ffffff); } .ds-disclosure[open] svg { transform: rotate(180deg); } .ds-reading-panel { padding: 0.75rem; border-top: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: color-mix(in oklab, var(--yellow, #f0c020) 25%, transparent); } .ds-disclosure summary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: 3px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-disclosure summary svg { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

components.name: Linked count
components.description: Each count links to the underlying work and names unavailable data.
components.html: —Changes since yesterday Unavailable
components.css: .ds-count { border: var(--rule, 2px) solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--yellow, #f0c020); } .ds-count a { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 1rem; padding: 0.875rem 1rem; color: var(--ink, #121212); text-decoration: none; font: 700 0.9375rem/1.25 Outfit, ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; transition: background-color 180ms ease-out; } .ds-count a:hover, .ds-count a:focus-visible { background: var(--surface, #ffffff); } .ds-count-number { display: grid; flex: none; place-items: center; box-sizing: border-box; width: 2.75rem; height: 2.75rem; border: 2px solid var(--ink, #121212); background: var(--surface, #ffffff); font-size: 1.25rem; font-weight: 900; line-height: 1; font-variant-numeric: lining-nums tabular-nums; } .ds-count small { display: block; margin-top: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.75rem; line-height: 1rem; font-weight: 500; } @media (min-width: 64rem) { .ds-count a { padding: 1rem 1.25rem; } } .ds-count a:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid var(--blue, #1040c0); outline-offset: -4px; } @media (prefers-reduced-motion: reduce) { .ds-count a { transition-duration: 0.01ms !important; } }

narrative.northStar: A Bauhaus poster for today's energy policy
narrative.overview: The visual system uses the directness of a 1920s Bauhaus poster. Oversized Outfit headlines, overlapping geometric forms, solid blocks of primary colour and weighty ink rules give Today its character. The same outlines, type and control states carry through to calmer white work surfaces for tables, research and long documents.
keyCharacteristics: Light-only canvas with red, blue and yellow accents.
Square work surfaces and hard, unblurred offsets.
Display typography and colour guide attention to the next task.
Source links and written availability stay visible alongside the data.
dos: Do use shared controls, square edges and hard offsets for data workspaces.
Do describe loading, missing data and source coverage in words.
Do retain visible keyboard focus and honour reduced-motion preferences.
donts: Don't add gradients or blur to the offset shadows.
Don't reproduce the Enel logo without supplied brand assets.
